messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary v3.8.1 p95 latency +42% vs baseline. Autorevert scheduled in 2m unless operator override. metrics: https://metrics/recent?span=5m
andre: Seeing this — looks like spike concentrated on route embed-eu-1. Hold auto if possible, need a quick look at traces.
sam: +1 to hold for 5m, will pull traces. If it's widespread we should let autorevert run.
morgan: I suspect a kv-cache eviction pattern from the new kernel flag. Seen similar in staging. Can someone check kvcache miss rate?
lina: If we end up reverting, I'll prepare a short customer note. Tagging CS for heads-up. @cs-desk
chelsea: Oncall here — I'll coordinate rollback runbook if we go manual. Who can execute a version pin?
andre: I can. Plan proposal: suppress autorevert, pin canary back to v3.8.0, scale down canary instances of 3.8.1, monitor p95 for 10m. If stable, promote a controlled rollout. @deploy-bot suppress timer?
deploy-bot: Operator override request received from andre. Autorevert timer suppressed for 15m.
sam: Quick checklist: 1) pin 3.8.0 on canary 2) drain 3.8.1 pods 3) confirm kvcache miss rate and kernel flag 4) notify CS/legal if we revert 5) file postmortem ticket.
morgan: Command to pin: ```bash
rls pin --env canary --to v3.8.0 --reason "p95 regression"
```
lina: Draft for CS: "We observed elevated inference latency with latest canary and are rolling back to the previous version while we investigate. No user data affected. We'll send updates within 30 minutes." Want to add legal review?
chelsea: Timeline: start rollback now, expected stable traffic in ~8–12m. I'll run the rollback runbook and watch metrics.
andre: Executing pin now.
deploy-bot: Executing command: `rls pin --env canary --to v3.8.0` — SUCCESS. Traffic routing updated.
morgan: kvcache misses spiked at 05:12, kernel flag 0x2 present on the new nodes. Looks correlated.
sam: p95 back to baseline after traffic shift. I'll keep a close eye for 20m.
lina: Sending CS note now, cc legal. Draft sent to #customer-success-digest.
chelsea: Opening postmortem ticket and linking traces. Marking severity P2.
andre: Loop closed — manual rollback executed, autorevert suppressed, CS notified. Will follow up with root-cause once tracing complete. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
